metadata.description: Skills for making web games with a coding agent: general game-making craft, and everything specific to PushPlay.

plugins.name: game-craft
plugins.description: Game-making skills for any web game: design briefs, game feel, levels, enemy AI, art direction, pixel art, 3D models, audio, UI, playtesting and performance.

plugins.name: pushplay
